lines.en: I fly through the ghost oak wood.
My wings are oddly square.
I pass the pale trunks.

lines.zh: 我的脸看着有点眼熟吧。
lines.en: My face looks familiar, does it not?
I tack between branches.

lines.zh: 飞过时我发出发闷的声。
lines.en: I make a muffled sound as I pass.

lines.zh: 我掠过树冠，惊起一群同类。
lines.en: I skim the canopy and startle a flock of my kin.
I land on a bare branch.
My shadow wobbles on the trunk.
I fly toward a smell of candy.
I skim the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 我贴着幽魂橡木的树皮飞。
lines.en: I skim the bark of a ghost oak.
My wingbeats are very regular.

lines.zh: 枯枝一响，我就换一根停。
lines.en: When a dead branch creaks, I move to another.
Fog. I cannot see far.
I rise above the canopy.
I hang face down.
I have candy in my pocket.

lines.zh: 幽魂橡木的叶子不发亮。
lines.en: Ghost oak leaves do not shine.

lines.zh: 我在听林子里空空的回声。
lines.en: I listen to the hollow echoes.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀收成两块方形。
lines.en: My wings fold into two squares.

lines.zh: 我身上有一股淡淡的糖味。
lines.en: A faint candy smell clings to me.
Pale and quiet here.

lines.zh: 树上很暗，我等着谁经过。
lines.en: The tree is dark; I wait for someone to pass.

lines.zh: 我倒挂在枝下，耳朵一动一动。
lines.en: Hanging upside down, my ears flick and flick.

lines.zh: 我眨了眨眼，表情没有变。
lines.en: I blink. The expression stays.

lines.zh: 树上除了我，什么都没有。
lines.en: Nothing on this tree but me.
I count tree shapes in the fog.
Does my face ring a bell?

lines.zh: 我在幽魂橡木林住很久了。
lines.en: I have lived here a long while.
Got any candy?
Do not grab. I will fly off.

lines.zh: 我这张脸是从哪儿来的？
lines.en: Where did this face come from?
You have stared long enough.

lines.zh: 这片林子的树都是白的。
lines.en: All the trees here are white.
I do not bite. I only look.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀把你的火光切成碎片。
lines.en: My wings chop your torchlight into pieces.

lines.zh: 我发出细小的吱声，你听不见。
lines.en: I let out a tiny squeak you cannot hear.
I wear a blocky little face.

lines.zh: 被打中后，我的耳朵还在抖。
lines.en: After the hit, my ears keep twitching.
I tumble once and steady.

lines.zh: 我记住了你手里的糖味。
lines.en: I remember the candy smell on you.

lines.zh: 腐木的碎屑落进我的毛里。
lines.en: Rotting wood crumbs fall into my fur.
I only squeak.
A small tear in my wing.
I rest on the branch.
That set me crooked in the air.
Still smelling candy. I am fine.
Candy? I want that.

lines.zh: 你把糖纸剥开，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw you unwrap it.
Put it on the branch.
Not bugs. Something sweet.
That candy smells familiar.
Do not shake. It will fall.
Too sweet. I am wary.
One will last me a while.
Hold it high. I will come.
Not the wrapper.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，我的脸还是那样。
lines.en: You hit me. My face does not change.

lines.zh: 我弹开一点，翅膀扇了两下。
lines.en: I bounce off and beat twice.

lines.zh: 我的身体比看起来的硬。
lines.en: I am harder than I look.
Not the wings.

lines.zh: 翅膀一收，我从缝里过去。
lines.en: Wings tucked, I slip through.
You step back; I return to the branch.
The bump flips me once.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在你手上刮了一下。
lines.en: My claws skid across your hand.

lines.zh: 我撞在你帽檐上，滚了半圈。
lines.en: I bump your hat brim and tumble half a turn.
I can still fly.

lines.zh: 这片林子里，我只见过自己。
lines.en: I have only seen myself here.

lines.zh: 这张脸，我也不知道是谁的。
lines.en: I do not know whose face this is.
Ask no more. The fog clears.
I do not much care.
No nests in the ghost oaks.
That leaves me wooden.

lines.zh: 我只是一只蝙蝠，就这样。
lines.en: I am only a bat. That is all.
Candy matters more.
Move along. I keep hanging.
Silence keeps me from saying wrong things.

lines.zh: 我抱着糖，飞得歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: I hug the candy and fly crooked.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，我放在枝上。
lines.en: I set your dropped thing on a branch.
I pinch the wrapper.
Too heavy. I cannot climb.
That does not look like candy.
The wrapper sticks to my claw; I cannot shake it.
I take the candy from the ground.
My grip is not nimble.
You take it. Not that one.
That will last me the night.
I see the candy in your hand.

lines.zh: 你走近树根，我松开爪子。
lines.en: You near the roots; I let go of the branch.
I fly your way.
My face stays on you.
I am after the candy.
Your raised hand is perfect.

lines.zh: 雾让我看不清，但我听得到。
lines.en: Fog hides you. I still hear.

lines.zh: 我锁定那颗小小的甜东西。
lines.en: I mark the small sweet thing.

lines.zh: 糖在你手上，我就跟着你的手。
lines.en: The candy is in your hand; I follow the hand.
Now I come.

lines.zh: 我这张方块脸，跟蝙蝠翅膀很配。
lines.en: This blocky face suits bat wings.
Lower and closer.
Is your arm tired yet?

lines.zh: 白树在后面，我很难看清。
lines.en: White trunks behind. Hard to see me.

lines.zh: 幽魂橡木的低枝，正好落我。
lines.en: A low ghost-oak branch suits me.
The sweetness is in your hand.
I try the side.
You move; I stop.

lines.zh: 你举着火把，我绕着火光转。
lines.en: You raise a torch; I circle its glow.
No hesitation this time.
I dive at your hand.

lines.zh: 爪子在你指节上刮了一下。
lines.en: My claws rake a knuckle.
That was for the candy.
My wing catches your face.
I bite the wrapper.

lines.zh: 我一头撞在你手背，又弹开。
lines.en: I ram your hand and bounce off.
Not painful. Just sudden.
The candy fell. I search.
I come back.

lines.zh: 我扑向你的手指，咬了一口。
lines.en: I lunge at your fingers and bite once.

lines.zh: 白树的枝上多了一个影子。
lines.en: A shape on a pale branch.
Wingbeats in the fog.
I hang from a ghost oak.
You look up and see a face.
The candy smell grows.

lines.zh: 幽魂橡木的树洞，是我的窝。
lines.en: A hollow in a ghost oak is my nest.
One more in the pale wood.
My wings sound in the fog.
A light squeak.
I land on the branch by you.
Fire curls a wing corner.

lines.zh: 我从枝上掉下去，翻了翻。
lines.en: I drop from the branch, tumbling.
Wet wings and I cannot fly.
The blast throws me into the fog.

lines.zh: 箭擦过耳膜，我差点摔下枝头。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my ear; I nearly fall off the branch.
Arts stiffen my wings.
No candy and my strength fades.
Lightning whitens the pale trees.
No ground below. Only void.
